subject: Life Skills
title: Financial Literacy Is a Life Skill
description: A 60-second lesson on Financial Literacy Is a Life Skill.

hook.text: Only 57% of American adults are financially literate. The rest navigate a complex money world using gut instinct alone.

buildup.text: Financial Literacy Is a Life Skill sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: Financially literate people save more, invest earlier, avoid predatory loans.

twist.text: Financial Literacy Is a Life Skill has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Financial Literacy Is a Life Skill matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Five concepts. One book. A lifetime of better decisions.

quiz.question: What five concepts cover most of financial literacy?
options: Stocks, bonds, real estate, futures, and options
Interest, inflation, diversification, budgeting, and taxes
Credit scores, mortgages, insurance, banking, and retirement
